description: Check a US postal address and return it in the normalized form the envelope will be printed with, plus any warnings. The address is checked against the Google Address Validation service, which receives the address and nothing else. Use this before create_draft whenever the address came from a person rather than from an earlier tool result. Requires a complete street address: this does not look up, append or find an address from a name, and it does not handle addresses outside the United States. This creates nothing and mails nothing.

address.description: A complete US postal address. US domestic addresses only.

line1.description: Street number and street name, or PO box.

name.description: The person or company the letter is addressed to.

postal_code.description: Five-digit ZIP or ZIP+4, such as 10001 or 10001-2345.

state.description: Two-letter US state or territory code, such as NY.

name: validate_address

anyOf.description: The address as USPS holds it. Pass these fields back verbatim when you create a draft.

postal_code.description: ZIP+4 where USPS supplied one, otherwise the five-digit ZIP.

address.description: Null when USPS could not answer about the address at all.

corrections.description: What USPS changed. Tell the user if it corrected anything material.

message.description: The sentence to act on. Read it before answering the user.

title: Validate a US Postal Address
